correctness.rationale: For two distinguished S5 partitions with cells of size <=2, represent nontrivial equivalence classes as two partial matchings. Their union decomposes uniquely into singleton vertices, alternating r-paths and doubled/even 2j-cycles. Event-uniform E^d reaches precisely graph-distance d balls, yielding component depths r-1 and j. The ordered relation K_R K_S has directed reachability increments R then S, giving diameter ceil(r/2) on paths and ceil(j/2) on 2j-cycles (including doubled 2-cycle). Taking P equal to the complement of a not-yet-reached vertex proves necessity for all events. Labeled component counts are 1, r!, (2j-1)! and exponential formula with the corresponding cutoffs yields both cumulative EGFs; differences yield exact histograms. Spanning paths give n! maximal parallel frames for n>=3; perfect-matchings-only case deletes paths/singletons. Independent literal enumeration of all ordered involution pairs n=1..6 reproduced all cumulative coefficients and both depth distributions, including n=6 parallel (1,855,1920,1560,720,720) and sequential (1,1215,3120,1440). Original verify.py source inspected; finite enumeration corroborates, does not replace component proof.
